Both reordered correctly to JavaScript tutorial, empty states, then CSS grid for Title Z–A.

Between the controls, version A — the dropdown — feels more natural to me. Sorting is something I set once and move on, so tucking the choices into a single menu keeps the top of the list tidy, and it'll hold up better if more sort options get added later. The row of buttons in version B takes up more space for something I don't change that often. So let's go with A.

On coverage: recently saved as the default, plus title A–Z and Z–A, covers most of what I reach for. The one I'd add is the reverse of the default — oldest saved first — for when I want to dig back to the things I saved a long time ago and haven't revisited. So: newest-first and oldest-first by date, and title both directions. With those, I think the sorting covers how I'd expect to work.
